text:
ben: Quick check-in on pilot rollout plan for the Optimize Toolkit (batching/caching/quant recs + eval-driven alerts). Need to finalize: pilot gating metrics, sampling heuristics for evals, per-tenant controls, and rollback automation.

carla: Summary of proposed gates:
- safety: concordance drop <= 4% vs float baseline on golden set
- perf: p95 latency regression <= 8% and no tail amplification
- econ: observed cost/token delta >= 10% in pilot traffic
- noise: eval-alert FPR <= 7% on sampled outputs
We should measure concordance across multiple prompt archetypes (few-shot, long context, chat).

alice: For per-tenant controls I want 3 layers: presets (safe/balanced/aggressive), per-tenant API overrides, and last-resort global kill-switch. Audit events for every change. Also expose a "dry-run" flag so customers can preview rec recommendations in logs without affecting runtime.

ben: Love the dry-run idea. Add it to the SDK. Example curl snippet for admin override: 

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/tenants/acme/optimize -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -d '{"preset":"safe","overrides":{"quant":"q4_0","enable_batching":false}}'

mike: On eval sampling: suggest stratified sampling by route + anomaly-priority bucket. That is, sample heavier from routes with higher user-visible variance and from cases where model length > 1024 tokens. Also keep a rolling reservoir of 5k golden outputs for delta checks.

carla: We need to define the golden set curation process. Proposal: initial golden set = combination of (1) curated regression prompts from SEs, (2) 1k production-sampled QA prompts anonymized, (3) customer-provided vignettes for pilot tenants. All stored hashed for privacy.

eva: QA checklist:
- unit-level diff tests for quantized kernels on held weights
- end-to-end concordance pipeline against golden set (automated daily runs)
- synthetic traffic for batching patterns: spiky vs steady; measure batch-size distribution and latency at p50/p95/p99
- chaos tests: drop cache or KV to ensure fail-open semantics

derek: Monitoring hooks: per-tenant time-series for concordance_pct, cache_hit_rate, avg_batch_size, tokens/sec, model_error_rate. We'll add anomaly detectors and two automated remediation actions: (A) auto-disable recommendation for tenant on concordance drop > 6% sustained 3m, (B) throttle batching aggressiveness if p95 latency > threshold. Both write an incident event and page on SEV for pilots.

alice: Docs & DX: include clear diagrams of rollout path, how to interpret concordance vs accuracy, SDK dry-run examples, and a decision flow for choosing presets. Also a FAQ covering why quant outputs differ and when to revert.

ben: Pilot plan: 4 tenants: acme, betacorp, charlie-inc, delta-startup. Timeline: internal alpha this week -> pilot rollout next Mon (5% traffic each) -> increase to 25% after 3 days if gates pass -> full pilot (100% for those tenants) for 10 days -> signoff.

mike: For canary checks we should run bootstrap significance tests on concordance delta (e.g., bootstrap CI of delta) rather than raw point estimates so we avoid noisy flips. If CI upper bound > 3% concordance loss, fail canary.

carla: Implementation notes: add per-route opt-in flag so customers can enable recs only on safe routes; store per-route policy in config; backend will evaluate routing and apply quant/batching policies based on route config.

eva: Pilot acceptance criteria (final):
- no SEV-level concordance regression across pilot tenants
- all automated rollbacks triggered correctly during induced failures
- docs + SDK dry-run published
- SRE runbook for manual rollback tested in staging

ben: Ops rollout steps: feature-flag via LaunchDarkly -> internal alpha with QA -> canary on prod cluster (5% traffic) -> pilot tenants -> GA. Automatic rollback triggers: 1) error rate delta > 0.4% sustained 5m, 2) concordance CI failure as mike suggested, 3) cache_hit_rate drop > 20%.

derek: We'll add a temporary dashboard tile for pilot owners showing live concordance bootstrap CIs and a small widget for sampled failing examples (with PII redacted). Paging rules: page if CI indicates significant drop and pager suppression off for pilot window.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: feature flag "optimize-toolkit-v1" created in LaunchDarkly. Canary job queued for cluster-prod-7.

ben: Owners: ben (PM) = pilot signoff + acceptance criteria, carla (ProdEng) = infra hooks + per-route policies, derek (SRE) = monitors + rollback automation, eva (QA) = golden set + test harness + chaos, alice (DevEx) = SDK dry-run + docs, mike (Data) = sampling & stats. Next check-in in 24h. TL;DR: finalize golden set curation, implement dry-run, add bootstrap CI to canary checks, per-tenant overrides + global kill-switch, pilot with 4 tenants on staged ramp.
